title: acleisanthes longiflora var. hirtella
intro: Acleisanthes longiflora var. hirtella, commonly known as Hairy Four O'Clock, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and acting as an antiseptic, antispasmodic, and antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Hairy Four O'Clock include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
